chapter: World's Greatest Jazz Band and Denver
title: Moving to Denver in 1973
summary: His wife liked Denver, so he moved there in 1973, ahead of many.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: What made you -- how did you start to think about coming out to Denver?
Well, the first time I came out, and then I came out again and I brought my wife.
Yeah. And she liked it.
And the kids. At the time they liked it. My wife really liked it.
Is she a New Yorker? Mildred?
No, she was born in Washington, D.C.
Oh, I see. She just liked how it was out here.
Yeah, she liked it out here.
Yeah, I can understand that.
So, she liked it.
So, in about '73 you moved out here?
I moved out here in '73.
You were one of the first people who wanted to move out of New York. Since then a lot of people have, but at the time people weren't moving out so fast, were they?
No, they weren't moving out too fast then.
No.
But I like it.
Yeah.
Que paso?
That date you were talking about, '72.
What date? Which one?
Turn it off a minute and we'll find out what --
(Recording interrupted.)
-- all right for dates, weren't we?
Yeah, so far.
